conclusion: No single Earth species total is scientifically interpretable without a declared estimand. Eukaryotic taxonomic-species estimates and microbial sequence-based richness estimates must be reported with their units and should not be added by default.
known_risks: The report is a research design and evidence synthesis, not a new empirical census.
A draw.io desktop executable was unavailable, so an editable .drawio source accompanies a native LaTeX-rendered workflow figure instead of a separately exported diagram image.
